B-001.description: Fresh stored manager: seven collapsed Teams, 42 child identities (details load when opened)

P-001.description: Cold frontend-store and warm reselection three-stage readiness

details.limits: Capture-phase trusted click → per-frame host/rows/target observer; collaboration may preload at role reveal, rowsPreloaded reported. Cold is fresh frontend store, not OS cache or full app launch. No user latency claim.

B-002.description: Independent disclosure button, exact copy/member, body and Enter/Space coordinator

B-003.description: Host reselection preserves manual choices; second same-address host isolated; fresh page restart resets

B-004.description: Actual Project Task-root click reveals only requested Team and selects its coordinator

B-006.description: Disclosure writes no persistent data or stop/cancel commands; Tasks/conversations unchanged

B-005.description: Real live Task checkpoint, a late delegated Team, reconnect and closure preserve choices/status/conversation

query ListWorkspaceRunHistory($limitPerAgent: Int = 6) {
  listWorkspaceRunHistory(limitPerAgent: $limitPerAgent) {
    workspaceRootPath
    workspaceName
    agentDefinitions {
      agentDefinitionId
      agentName
      runs {
        runId
        summary
        createdAt
        archivedAt
        terminatedAt
        status
        isActive
        shouldConnectStream
        statusSource
        hasCollaboration
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    teamDefinitions {
      teamDefinitionId
      teamDefinitionName
      runs {
        teamRunId
        teamDefinitionId
        teamDefinitionName
        coordinatorAddress
        workspaceRootPath
        summary
        createdAt
        archivedAt
        terminatedAt
        isActive
        rootTeam
        members {
          memberAddress
          displayName
          agentRunId
          status
          runtimeKind
          workspaceRootPath
          __typename
        }
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
